snippet.title: Our Monsoon Balcony Trailer
snippet.description:
Our Monsoon Balcony is a short, atmospheric narrative game crafted with a RPG Maker MV engine and presented in monochrome pixel art.

You play as Arka, an office worker living through the rainy season, one quiet evening, a new encounter on the balcony changes everything. As daily routines unfold and the rain keeps falling, fragments of memory, emotion, and mystery begin to intertwine.

PLAY NOW: https://rakoratsu.itch.io/our-monsoon-balcony
